Problem: Teacher classroom records (attendance; lateness; homework; remarks)
Current situation: Teachers fill paper books → books go to floor admin → admin sends WhatsApp for homework; tracks absences manually
Solution proposed: Teacher interface: own classes/students; attendance; lateness; remarks; daily homework (required). Data goes automatically to floor admin. Floor admin sees remarks/absences; builds student stats for parents; can send homework automatically.
Open points / notes: Biggest flag. Decide homework delivery: WhatsApp groups vs parent/student space (or both).

Current situation: Parents lack one place for child info → many questions/conflicts via WhatsApp/calls
Solution proposed: Parent login (student ID + password). See: child profile; class; year; subjects; teachers office hours; announcements; remarks; marks; timetable; absences; lateness; homework. Submit réclamations (tracked: new / in progress / resolved). Optional: alerts; justify absence; meeting request; multi-child account; document download.
Open points / notes: Depends on teacher + admin data being in the system first.

Current situation: 3 fingerprint machines → USB export each → WhatsApp to Manel/Hichem → manual check of delays/absences → istifsar → person justifies
Solution proposed: Import pointage into system (auto-integrate machines if possible; else manual export→import). Auto-flag delays/absences; auto email/WhatsApp alerts; history as proof; admin remarks on employees/teachers.
Open points / notes: Try machine integration first; fallback = file import.

Current situation: Director tells Manel → Manel makes image (ChatGPT) → posts WhatsApp groups
Solution proposed: Announcement tool: create once; choose audience (class / primary / middle / all); publish. Auto send to WhatsApp and/or show in parent space. Optional templates/image generator.
Open points / notes: Same delivery choice as homework: WhatsApp vs in-app (or both).

Current situation: Office hours not stored in one clear place parents can see
Solution proposed: Admin or teachers enter office hours in system; parents see them on teacher/child pages.

Current situation: Done on WhatsApp — easy to miss; hard to track
Solution proposed: Shared calendar/schedule in system: create meeting; date/time; invite; reminders.
Open points / notes: Can later extend to teacher–parent meetings.

Current situation: Students leave class ~30 min early; called via loudspeaker (mokabir essawt) when parents arrive — noise; lost class time; chaos at exit
Solution proposed: Pickup request in system: parent arrives / requests child → gate or admin marks arrival → teacher (or class screen) gets a silent notification for that student only → student leaves when called. Optional: parent app button "I am here"; queue by time; no early mass exit.
Open points / notes: Decide: parent self-check-in vs gate staff only. Can link to parent portal (Priority 2).

Current situation: Justifications handled informally (paper/WhatsApp); linked to classroom + pointage issues
Solution proposed: Parent or employee submits justification in system; admin validates; linked to absence record.

Current situation: Parents should see marks; entry process still unclear / likely manual or scattered
Solution proposed: Teacher (or admin) enters marks in system; parents see them in parent space; history kept.
Open points / notes: Needed to fully deliver parent portal value.

Current situation: Timetables shared or updated manually; parents need a reliable view
Solution proposed: Central timetable per class; updates visible to teachers; parents; students.
Open points / notes: Supports parent portal + homework by day.

Current situation: Reports and school documents often sent manually (print/WhatsApp)
Solution proposed: Upload bulletins/documents in system; parent downloads securely.

Current situation: Parent complaints often via WhatsApp/calls — no status tracking
Solution proposed: Admin inbox for réclamations; assign; reply; close; keep history.

Current situation: Different floors/admins/teachers; risk of seeing wrong data if not structured
Solution proposed: Clear roles: teacher; floor admin; HR/admin; director; secretary; parent. Each sees only what they need.
Open points / notes: Cross-cutting — design early even if built step by step.
